Angelic Davis (angelic.davis@enron.com) sent 6 unique messages to dana.davis@enron.com between 2001-10-01 and 2001-11-01 (end exclusive). Dana was in To or Cc on all six. I filtered on sender, recipient and date, and the query returned each message once.

ANSWER: 6
SOURCES: Eec51ca95dc10, E78c208665714, Ea4671be47808, Ea9e43a0d11aa, Ef703ce92e611

eSource@ENRON (40enron@enron.com) sent the most messages on 2001-09-05. It sent 23 that day, out of 160 messages in September 2001. The next busiest days were 2001-09-28 with 19 and 2001-09-14 with 16.

I counted messages by UTC send date, using only the sender address. I didn't open any message bodies. The source ID below is just the first message in that September set, not one from 09-05.

ANSWER: 2001-09-05
SOURCES: E80e4adf85ec0

Vince Kaminski sent the most messages in April 2001 to vkaminski@aol.com, with 173 unique messages. I counted every message he sent that month, with each address in To or Cc counted once per message. He sent 458 messages in total.

The next highest was his own enron.com address, with 135 messages. After that came shirley.crenshaw@enron.com, with 54.

ANSWER: vkaminski@aol.com
SOURCES: Ea8262445477a

Vince Kaminski sent the most messages on 2001-04-25, with 47. I counted messages from vince.kaminski@enron.com sent in April 2001, grouped by UTC date. The next highest days were 2001-04-11 with 37 and 2001-04-27 with 36. I didn't open individual messages, so the SOURCES line is empty.

ANSWER: 2001-04-25
SOURCES:

Jeff Dasovich sent the most messages to Richard Sanders in that window. I filtered messages with richard.sanders@enron.com in To or Cc from 2001-05-29 up to but not including 2001-06-05. That gave 37 messages, and Dasovich sent 8 of them. Susan Mara was next with 5, then Janette Elbertson with 4.

The sources below are 5 of Dasovich's 8 messages.

ANSWER: jeff.dasovich@enron.com
SOURCES: Ec64a0fe2fe15, Efbeffae21bed, Eb4461cb03bfd, E89c6a95fd0e2, Eaa28b1519008

The number 703-227-8777 appears in one message, **Ef817f5aac97c**. Bryant Frihart sent it on 2001-08-24, and the subject is "FW: 082501 Enron Confirmation". It went to hayhurstb@paceglobal.com, with Tammy Gilmore and C. Giron on Cc. The number appears in the message as "703.227.8777 Phone". I found it with a regex search, and that search returned only this message.

ANSWER: bryant.frihart@enron.com
SOURCES: Ef817f5aac97c

The reference ORE-7509 appears in one message, **E2083b9620d07**. It was sent on 2002-02-27 with the subject "(CMS-26) NOTICE OF INTENTION TO TRANSFER MEMBERSHIP".

The sender is marketing@nymex.com, shown as "Exchange Information @ENRON". The message is in the deleted_items folder of custodian shackleton-s. The matching line reads "Edward Orenchuk (ORE-7509)".

ANSWER: marketing@nymex.com
SOURCES: E2083b9620d07

The exact string "EB-2934" (with the hyphen) appears in only one message.

That message is E2093dccd9417, "PSEG Meeting", sent on 2000-12-05 by Robin Barbe (robin.barbe@enron.com) to Chris Germany and Dick Jenkins. It gives the meeting location as "EB-2934". Eight other messages write the room as "EB2934" without the hyphen. They are meeting notices from other senders, and I left them out.

ANSWER: robin.barbe@enron.com
SOURCES: E2093dccd9417

j.kaminski@enron.com and vkaminski@aol.com look like the same person, but they are different addresses, so I counted both. I didn't list message ids, so the SOURCES line is empty.

SOURCES:

More messages containing "Dynegy" were sent on 2000-05-23 than on any other day in May 2000. A case-insensitive search of the full text of every message from 2000-05-01 up to 2000-06-01 matched 103 messages, and 14 of them were sent on 2000-05-23.

The next highest days were 2000-05-04 and 2000-05-19, with 10 each. I didn't open individual messages, so I have no source IDs to cite.

ANSWER: 2000-05-23
SOURCES:

The sender address with the most messages containing "Azurix" between 2000-12-01 and 2001-01-01 (UTC) is enron.announcements@enron.com. A case-insensitive search of the full text of every message in that window found 35 unique matches. I counted them by sender. This address sent 7. The next was jeffrey.shankman@enron.com with 5.

ANSWER: enron.announcements@enron.com
SOURCES: E96a5b972d3f6, E7b023b949b19, E94c1e8a87a5e

The only message that mentions 703-227-8777 is E f817f5aac97c (id Ef817f5aac97c). It was sent on 2001-08-24 by bryant.frihart@enron.com. The number appears in it as "703.227.8777 Phone", which is why an exact-format search missed it at first.

A count of messages from that sender dated 2001-08-01 up to 2001-09-01 UTC returned 2. That count includes the message itself.

ANSWER: 2
SOURCES: Ef817f5aac97c
